title: Yoisaki Kanade — Memories Reclaimed〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...
Thank you, Kanade. For letting us listen to your song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-It was so good...
My chest feels tight, but it puts me at peace at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was able to make it into something I'm happy with thanks to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mentioned this back when I played you the demo, but things just weren't clicking before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then I heard all of your thoughts, which helped me pinpoint the parts that felt off to me and fix them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was completely different from before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
I suppose so, since I changed the melody.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, you sure threw us for a loop with that. Still, I'm really glad it worked out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd already made a lot of progress on the lyrics and illustrations at that point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I really wanted to incorporate their ideas.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it. I mean, it made for a better song.
Right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think this new melody does a better job of conveying the song's message.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be on my way too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I will too, then.
Please do drop by again anytime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought I heard a child's voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
I'm pretty sure I stopped playing Untitled, so why am I still in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, something's glowing by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Here it is... This reminds me of that ball of light I picked up before... The fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this is much smaller, and it's shaped like a shard that broke off of something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How strange.
That child's voice... Was it just my imagination...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, that was a child's voice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So you heard it too, KAITO.
I think it was coming from the direction of...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Is that... Kanade?
I thought she went back...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...!
Was that... A fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, something seems off... What could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling things are about to get interesting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't even touch that glowing shard, so why am I in some strange place again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's the same voice I heard a minute ago... Still, there's something nostalgic about it. I wonder why...)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: I've been waiting so, so long...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line:
Ack...
If all these flashes keep happening, I'm going to lose my eyesight...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: I thought I heard Luka and KAITO, but what's going on now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: Oh... So you two are here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: That's a relief. I suddenly ended up in this strange place, so I was trying to figure out what to do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: From the way you're talking, it sounds like you're the same on the inside...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Tell me, Kanade.
While you're talking to us like this, doesn't something feel a little off?

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line:
...
Now that you mention it, my voice sounds kind of...high-pitched...

rows.Speaker: Kanade?
rows.Line: Huh? Were you two always this tall?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Figure it out already. You're the one who's shrunk.
